React renders Portuguese Owner controls; it cannot grant a permission or bypass a state transition. Temporary chat is never accepted by a tool mutation command. Safe mode blocks session creation, preview, approval, confirmation, and execution; read-only catalog and existing audit/history inspection remain available for recovery visibility.
